2105-3603-4742-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3603-4742-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3603-4742-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1856-3899-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: Doom Weaver paired with the persist creature.
1856-3899-6249--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Doom Weaver trigger.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver and Olivia trigger.
Resolve the Doom Weaver ability, pairing it with the persist creature.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from the persist creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

728-1349-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
728-1349-6854.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Host of the Hereafter's ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Host of the Hereafter.
When Host of the Hereafter dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Host of the Hereafter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 6.
Repeat.

3317-5972-8095.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3317-5972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-2204-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Scholar of New Horizons.
When Scholar of New Horizons dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6972-7236.easyPrerequisites: The total toughness of creatures you control excluding Towering Titan is at least X.
4247-6972-7236.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Towering Titan.
When Towering Titan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3967-6012--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3967-6012--5--195.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1115-1563-3899-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5434-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5434-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

647-1368-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
647-1368-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

232-1235-4285-7487.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with seven or more +1/+1 counters on it

1597-4687-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gyre Sage.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

4929-5660-7388.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-1563-2457-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

413-5220-7332.description:
Cast Casey & Raph by paying {4}{R}.
When Casey & Raph enters, it and Blasting Station trigger. Choose Casey & Raph's first mode targeting yourself.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Casey & Raph.
When Casey & Raph dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Casey & Raph onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Resolve the Casey & Raph trigger from step 2, causing you to exile Casey & Raph from the top of your ability with the ability to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Cast Casey & Raph from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7235.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three total creatures on the battlefield.
5147-6972-7235.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Stag Beetle.
When Stag Beetle dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2366-3322-5702-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3322-5702-6633.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

147-780-5147.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 5.

1414-2099-2866-4986.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

2173-3967-5220-6537.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

2173-2438-3239-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

1329-1778-2178-2511.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-2511.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

465-803-1251-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1491-2757-3430-6218.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pheres-Band Tromper, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1636-3143-6164.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one green creature token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-6164.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of a green creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Yorvo trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Yorvo trigger, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.

2316-2440-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-2440-4871.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins.
When the Goblins die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Warrens ability, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
When the Goblins enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers three times, adding {C}{C}{C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

659-1849-4381-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-1849-4381-4613.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

1461-1818-4050-4078.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1461-1818-4050-4078.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers twice, causing you to gain 4 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

895-2882-3079-4999.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Darigaaz's Attendant.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
895-2882-3079-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Darigaaz's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Hollow One by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {B}{R}{G}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

500-2047-3129-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary artifact creature that does not have Mechanized Production attached.
500-2047-3129-4365.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying a nonlegendary artifact creature you control and creating eight token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

914-2034-3458-5220.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least one aritfact and/or enchantment.
914-2034-3458-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dockside Extortionist on top of your library from your graveyard.
Actviate Impromptu Raid by paying {2}{R/G}, revealing Dockside Extortionist from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least one Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

315-399-2034-5243.notablePrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to a creature you control.
315-399-2034-5243.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metallic Sliver, adding {C}{C}.
Metallic Sliver is put on top of your library instead of your graveyard due to its ability granted by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast Metallic Sliver from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1283-2034-3029-4408.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Merfolk Secretkeeper, adding {2}.
Cast Venture Deeper from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {1}, causing target player to mill four cards and exiling Venture Deeper.
Cast Merfolk Secretkeeper from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1124-1170-4012.notablePrerequisites:
Tasha has at least three loyalty counters on it.
An opponent has an instant and/or sorcery in their graveyard.
1124-1170-4012.description:
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an additional activation of each of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Tasha's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to draw a card and exile an instant and/or sorcery card from an opponent's graveyard with a page counter on it.
Activate Tasha's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, casting an instant or sorcery spell with a page counter on it from exile.
Displacer Kitten and Tasha trigger.
Resolve the Tasha trigger, creating a 3/3 Demon creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Tasha.
Resolve the instant or sorcery spell.
Repeat from step 2.
Note that you must abide by targeting restrictions when casting the instant or sorcery spell, and so not all instants and/or sorceries in your opponent' graveyards may work for this combo.

2011-3129-4076.easyPrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
2011-3129-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Najeela and Burakos triggers.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating two 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Burakos trigger, creating eight Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

2060-2265-2854-3977.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
2060-2265-2854-3977.description:
Cast Horned Kavu, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {R}{G}.
Horned Kavu triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

799-1271-3212.description:
Tap Scroll Rack and pay {1} to activate it, putting Karn's Temporal Sundering on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Karn's Temporal Sundering, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {2}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn and returning up to one nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
